subject: Performance incidents and proposed premium pathway + credit exception
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@nimbus-fin.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@nimbus-fin.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in API p95s last week — urgent

Hi Hannah,

Last week we saw two incidents where our production requests to the Redwood API spiked to p95 latencies of ~1.5s for several hours. Our users noticed timeouts in some customer flows and our SRE had to route traffic to a fallback. We rely on your hosted service for critical parts of our real-time risk scoring, so this materially impacted us.

Can you share what happened, an impact analysis, and whether Redwood can make an exception to the renewal SLA terms we are negotiating? We are midway through a renewal discussion (deal NIM-2027-042) and this makes us worried about staying on the standard tier.

We need:
- Root cause and mitigation timeline
- Whether Redwood will provide a credit for the disruption window (we track lost ops)
- Options to get a higher-availability path (dedicated/premium) and pricing impact

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Park
VP, Platform Operations
Nimbus Financial

Attachments: q3-latency-spike-analysis.pdf (we attached our internal timeline)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@nimbus-fin.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@nimbus-fin.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in API p95s last week — urgent

Hi Jenna — thank you for the note and the timeline. I’m very sorry Nimbus ran into the timeout issues. I’ve looped Marcus from our reliability team to provide a technical recap; below is what we can commit to immediately and in parallel with a deeper RCA.

Short-term:
- We can offer a one-time credit that covers the incident window while we complete RCA. I’m proposing a 10% credit on August 31–September 2 bill for hosted requests that hit the degraded p95.
- As an operational mitigant, we can enable a regional preference and traffic pinning for your primary region starting within 48 hours. This reduces cross-region cold-paths that contributed to the spikes.

Longer-term options:
- Pilot Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) for your high-priority risk-scoring routes — this gives you isolated capacity and stronger latency SLOs.
- If you prefer to remain on hosted, we have a Premium SLA tier that includes tighter p95 targets and faster incident response; it also comes with a structured incident credit policy.

Can we schedule a short call Wednesday to review numbers and draft a renewal amendment? I’ll prepare a proposed amendment that includes the credit and a path to Premium or Dedicated.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed amendment placeholder (I’ll share a draft after engineering notes)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Spike in API p95s last week — urgent

Hannah — quick tech dump to include in the RCA:
- Incident was driven by a model rollout that increased median token counts on a subset of requests; autoscaling headroom in the affected pool was consumed faster than expected because our continuous-batching heuristic misclassified those sequences as cold starts.
- Root cause: rollout introduced a new attention kernel variant that had suboptimal perf at shorter sequences due to a memory layout change; this regressed p95 under bursty load.
- Immediate mitigation: rollback to previous kernel for the affected pool (completed 2027-09-01 03:40 UTC). We also increased pre-warm thresholds for the next 72 hours and added an alert rule for delta in median sequence length by route.
- Follow-ups: patch upcoming to alter kernel selection and add a canary with synthetic load to catch this class of regressions.

I recommend offering Nimbus: 1) 10% credit for the incident window as Hannah suggested, and 2) an accelerated Dedicated pilot with two-week no-cost trial on a small pool so they can validate p95 stability before committing.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal patch notes (summarized for customer)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@nimbus-fin.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@nimbus-fin.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed amendment + pilot offer (NIM-2027-042)

Hi Jenna/Team — following up with a concrete proposal after our internal review. Inline summary and the attached draft amendment.

What we will do now:
- 10% service credit for billed hosted usage during the incident window (Aug 31—Sep 2).
- Offer a two-week Dedicated pilot at no charge for up to 4 vGPU-equivalent capacity aimed at your risk-scoring routes. The pilot includes: configuration assistance, enhanced observability, and a post-trial stability report.
- If the pilot meets the agreed p95 targets, we’ll provide a 30-day option to convert to a discounted Dedicated commitment level for Nimbus with a preferential SLA (SLA delta: p95 target lowered by 40% over standard).

Next steps we propose:
1) Sign the attached amendment covering the credit and pilot logistics.
2) Kick off pilot the week of Sep 20; we will assign a technical lead and SRE contact.
3) Review pilot telemetry and decide on Dedicated conversion or Premium hosted tier by Oct 15.

If you want, Marcus can join tomorrow’s 30-minute call to walk through the technical mitigations.

Thanks — hoping this addresses immediate concerns while keeping your renewal path flexible.

Best,
Hannah

Attachment: nimbus-proposed-amendment-draft.pdf
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-nimbus-amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/34567 (deal NIM-2027-042)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@nimbus-fin.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@nimbus-fin.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment + pilot offer (NIM-2027-042)

Hannah — thanks for the speedy, concrete response and for looping Marcus. The 10% credit and the two-week Dedicated pilot are both acceptable to us as a path forward. We appreciate the no-cost pilot — that’s the clearest way for us to validate stability without immediately committing to the premium pricing.

We’d like to: 1) sign the amendment (I’ll route it internally today via DocuSign), 2) run the pilot the week of Sep 27 instead (our ops calendar is tight week of Sep 20), and 3) include a clause that if p95s exceed the agreed target during pilot we get a further good-faith credit negotiation for the affected billing period.

Can you confirm the pilot start flexibility and the addendum language? If you confirm, I’ll get DocuSign moving and Alex will coordinate access details with your SRE team.

Jenna

--
Jenna Park
VP, Platform Operations
Nimbus Financial
